integrity: The enumerative formula, residue-chain intersection counts, and cyclic-action freeness are proved explicitly. Exact-arithmetic verification and a direct finite synchronizability census were replayed, but do not replace the all-order proof. Previously recorded eight-state numerical counts are credited as prior finite evidence.
scientific_limitations: Prime-power state numbers, fixed full-cycle permutation and second letter of exact defect one; excludes general ranks, mixed-prime state counts and reset-threshold spectra. Relies on a cited published primitive-automaton theorem; prior-art search is not historical certification.
title: Exact nonsynchronization counts for prime-power circular defect-one automata
